from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status, Query
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import jwt, JWTError
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import uuid

# Configuration
SECRET_KEY = "supersecretkey"
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60

# Password hashing
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

# OAuth2 scheme
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/login")

app = FastAPI(title="NeighborhoodIssueReportAPI", version="1.0.0")

# Mock neighborhood resolution using bounding boxes
NEIGHBORHOODS = [
    {"name": "Downtown", "lat_min": 40.700, "lat_max": 40.800, "lon_min": -74.000, "lon_max": -73.900},
    {"name": "Midtown", "lat_min": 40.750, "lat_max": 40.780, "lon_min": -73.990, "lon_max": -73.950},
    {"name": "Uptown", "lat_min": 40.800, "lat_max": 40.900, "lon_min": -73.950, "lon_max": -73.850},
    {"name": "Brooklyn", "lat_min": 40.650, "lat_max": 40.700, "lon_min": -73.990, "lon_max": -73.900},
]

def resolve_neighborhood(lat: float, lon: float) -> str:
    for nb in NEIGHBORHOODS:
        if nb["lat_min"] <= lat <= nb["lat_max"] and nb["lon_min"] <= lon <= nb["lon_max"]:
            return nb["name"]
    return "Unknown"

# Database dependency
def get_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect("db.sqlite3")
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        yield conn
    finally:
        conn.close()

# Startup event to create tables
@app.on_event("startup")
def startup():
    conn = sqlite3.connect("db.sqlite3")
    try:
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                profile_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                category TEXT NOT NULL,
                description TEXT NOT NULL,
                neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
                profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
            )
        """)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

# Pydantic models
class RegisterRequest(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr
    password: str

class RegisterResponse(BaseModel):
    profile_id: str

class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr
    password: str

class LoginResponse(BaseModel):
    token: str
    profile_id: str

class ReportSubmission(BaseModel):
    category: str
    description: str
    latitude: float
    longitude: float

class ReportResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    category: str
    description: str
    neighborhood: str
    profile_id: str
    created_at: datetime

class AggregateEntry(BaseModel):
    category: str
    count: int

# Authentication helpers
def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + (expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES))
    to_encode.update({"exp": int(expire.timestamp())})
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)

def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        user_id: int = payload.get("sub")
        if user_id is None:
            raise credentials_exception
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception
    user = db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
    if user is None:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user

# Routes
@app.post("/register", response_model=RegisterResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def register(request: RegisterRequest, db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    # Check if email already registered
    existing = db.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (request.email,)).fetchone()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Email already registered")

    profile_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    hashed_pw = pwd_context.hash(request.password)
    try:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, profile_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (request.email, hashed_pw, profile_id)
        )
        db.commit()
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Registration failed")
    return RegisterResponse(profile_id=profile_id)

@app.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse)
def login(request: LoginRequest, db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?", (request.email,)).fetchone()
    if not user or not pwd_context.verify(request.password, user["password_hash"]):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Invalid email or password")
    token = create_access_token({"sub": user["id"]})
    return LoginResponse(token=token, profile_id=user["profile_id"])

@app.post("/reports", response_model=ReportResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_report(
    report: ReportSubmission,
    current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)
):
    neighborhood = resolve_neighborhood(report.latitude, report.longitude)
    report_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO reports (id, user_id, category, description, neighborhood, profile_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (report_id, current_user["id"], report.category, report.description, neighborhood,
         current_user["profile_id"], created_at)
    )
    db.commit()
    return ReportResponse(
        id=report_id,
        category=report.category,
        description=report.description,
        neighborhood=neighborhood,
        profile_id=current_user["profile_id"],
        created_at=created_at
    )

@app.get("/reports", response_model=list[ReportResponse])
def get_own_reports(
    current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)
):
    rows = db.execute(
        "SELECT id, category, description, neighborhood, profile_id, created_at FROM reports WHERE user_id = ?",
        (current_user["id"],)
    ).fetchall()
    return [ReportResponse(**row) for row in rows]

@app.get("/issues/aggregate", response_model=list[AggregateEntry])
def aggregate_issues(area: str = Query(...), db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    if not area:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="area parameter required")
    rows = db.execute(
        "SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports WHERE neighborhood = ? GROUP BY category",
        (area,)
    ).fetchall()
    return [AggregateEntry(category=row["category"], count=row["count"]) for row in rows]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
